code_verification.verified: confirmed against QCAA-published ACARA v9.0 alignment documents
code_verification.approximate: follows v9.0 code convention; re-verify at australiancurriculum.edu.au before publication

skills.name: Numbers to 100: count, read, write, order
skills.desc: recognise, model, read, write and order numbers to at least 100; locate numbers on a number line

skills.name: Place value: partition, exchange, represent (tens & ones)
skills.desc: develop understanding of place value for partitioning, exchanging and representing one- and two-digit numbers in various ways

skills.name: Counting sequences (1s, 2s, 5s, 10s) from any start
skills.desc: develop confidence with number sequences to and from 100 by ones from any starting point; skip count by twos, fives and tens

skills.name: Add & subtract within 20 (counting on, partitioning)
skills.desc: represent and solve simple addition and subtraction problems using a range of strategies including counting on, partitioning and rearranging parts

skills.name: Add & subtract 2-digit numbers without regrouping
skills.desc: add and subtract suitable two-digit numbers using place-value strategies (ones with ones, tens with tens), without regrouping

skills.name: Halves of a whole
skills.desc: recognise and describe one-half as one of two equal parts of a whole

skills.name: Time: o'clock, half past, nearest 5 minutes
skills.desc: use time language, read and write the hour and half past, tell time to the nearest 5 minutes

skills.name: Money: coins and notes to $20
skills.desc: model and count Australian coins and notes to $20

skills.name: 2D & 3D shapes: compare, classify, describe
skills.desc: compare and classify two-dimensional and three-dimensional shapes and describe them using informal language

skills.name: Numbers to 1,000: represent, order, place value
skills.desc: recognise, represent and order numbers to at least 1000 using physical and virtual materials, numerals and number line

skills.name: Place value: partition, exchange, regroup (2–3 digits)
skills.desc: apply place value to partition, rearrange and rename two- and three-digit numbers in terms of their parts and regroup partitioned numbers to assist in calculations

skills.name: Add & subtract 1–3 digit numbers (with regrouping)
skills.desc: add and subtract one-, two- and three-digit numbers, including regrouping, using efficient strategies

skills.name: Times-2 facts + related division (doubling/halving)
skills.desc: recall and demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for twos; extend and apply facts to develop the related division facts using doubling and halving

skills.name: Unit fractions 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 + multiples to a whole
skills.desc: recognise, represent and order unit fractions including 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 and their multiples to a complete whole

skills.name: Time: quarter past, days between events (calendar)
skills.desc: use time language, read and write the hour, half past and quarter past, tell time to the nearest 5 minutes; determine the number of days between events using a calendar

skills.name: Money: coins and notes to $100
skills.desc: model and count Australian coins and notes to $100

skills.name: Number patterns (sequences by 2, 3, 5, 10)
skills.desc: investigate number sequences, initially those increasing and decreasing by twos, threes, fives and tens from any starting point, then moving to other sequences

skills.name: Numbers to 10,000: represent, order, round
skills.desc: recognise, represent and order natural numbers using naming and writing conventions for numerals to at least 10,000

skills.name: Odd & even numbers
skills.desc: investigate the conditions required for a number to be odd or even and identify odd and even numbers

skills.name: Add & subtract 3–4 digit numbers
skills.desc: extend and apply knowledge of addition and subtraction facts to 20 to develop efficient mental strategies for computation with larger numbers without a calculator (3- and 4-digit sums/differences to 10,000)

skills.name: Missing values (addition/subtraction as inverse ops)
skills.desc: recognise and explain the connection between addition and subtraction as inverse operations; apply to partition numbers and find unknown values in number sentences

skills.name: Times-3, 4, 5, 10 facts + related division
skills.desc: recall and demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10; extend and apply facts to develop the related division facts

skills.name: Division: equal sharing (intro)
skills.desc: use the connection between multiplication and division to solve simple division (equal sharing) problems

skills.name: Unit fractions 1/2…1/10, fractions of a set, combine to whole
skills.desc: recognise and represent unit fractions including 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 and 1/10 and their multiples in different ways; combine fractions with the same denominator to complete the whole

skills.name: Time: to the nearest minute
skills.desc: use time language, read and write time to the nearest minute; solve simple elapsed-time problems

skills.name: Money contexts: totals, change to nearest 5c
skills.desc: use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving additive and multiplicative situations including financial contexts; formulate problems using number sentences
